item.text: The billing service already resolves a plan from the subscription, but the other services and UI still read the organization’s stored plan directly. I’m going to centralize the effective plan on organization reads so existing mismatched records are corrected in behavior immediately, without needing another plan change.

item.text: Organization reads now return the subscription plan when one exists and retain the workspace plan as the fallback. That makes existing quotas, feature checks, server rendered plan labels, and other consumers of these reads follow the same current plan. I’m also correcting the trial sweep to select only subscriptions that remain in `trialing` status.

The key runtime paths now share the subscription-backed organization read, including rate limiting, which refreshes the org’s plan before choosing burst capacity. I’m checking the remaining usages of the stored plan and the trial status transition logic for gaps before finishing.
